test_title: RRB NTPC CBT-I Official Paper (Held On: 8 Jan 2021 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: The compound interest on a certain sum of money at the rate of 11% p.a. for 2 years is Rs. 4642. Find its simple interest at the same rate and for the same period.
solution:
**Given:**

Compound Interest on a sum for 2 years at 11% p.a. = Rs.4642

**Formulas used:**

Compound Interest + Principal = Amount 

⇒ Amount = Principal × (1 + R/100)ⁿ

Simple Interest = Principal × Rate/100 × Time 

**Calculation:**

4642 + P = P × (1 + 11/100)²

⇒ 4642 = P × 111/100 × 111/100 - P 

⇒ 4642 = P(111/100 × 111/100 - 1)

⇒ 4642 = P(12321 - 10000)/10000

⇒ 4642 = P × 2321/10000 

⇒ P = 4642 × 10000/2321 

⇒ P = Rs.20000

**∴ Simple Interest = 20000 × 11/100 × 2 = Rs.4400**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__** Percentage MethodCompound interest and simple interest both are calculated on Principal. Effective rate percent of compound interest for 2 years = R + R + (R × R)/100 

⇒ 11 + 11 + (11 × 11)/100 

⇒ 22 + 1.21 = 23.21% 

Simple interest rate percent for 2 years = Rate % × Time = 11% × 2 = 22% 

23.21% of Principal = Rs.4642 

⇒ 22% of Principal = Rs.4642 × 22%/23.21% = Rs.4400 

**∴ The simple interest is Rs.4400.**
